t: World Backs Fairer Maps — US Casts Lone Vote Against
d: The UN General Assembly voted 164-1 to encourage governments, schools and tech companies to use map projections that represent the relative size of continents more accurately, UN News reported.

t: Russia Launches Group Strikes on Ukraine's Metallurgical Plants, Logistics Hubs
d: the Russian Armed Forces carried out a group strike using precision-guided ground-launched weapons and long-range strike drones, targeting metallurgical plants in the Dnepropetrovsk region that supply Ukraine's defense industry

t: Russia-US Dialogue Source of Irritation for EU, Zelensky - Russian Diplomat
d: Contacts and the dialogue between Moscow and Washington are a source of irritation for Europe and Volodymyr Zelensky, Russian Foreign Ministry Ambassador-at-Large on Ukraine's crimes Rodion Miroshnik said.

t: Russian Forces Liberate Kurtovka Settlement in Donetsk People's Republic
d: Russian armed forces have taken control of the settlement of Kurtovka in the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR), the Russian Defense Ministry said on Saturday.

t: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner Arrive in Moscow for Diplomatic Talks

t: Putin Orders Halt to Strikes on Kiev for Three Days, Starting From Midnight Today - Kremlin
d: Russia will halt strikes on Ukraine's capital as US special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrive in Moscow for talks on the Ukrainian conflict.

t: Russian Forces Strike Enemy Vessels and Drone Production Facilities in Precision Operations
d: In a series of targeted strikes, Russian Armed Forces have successfully neutralized four enemy vessels in the ports of Chernomorsk and Odessa, the Russian Ministry of Defense reported on Saturday.

t: Russia's Rosatom Develops 99.9% Pure Germanium Tech to Close Key Import Gap

t: Russian Strikes Keep Disrupting Western Arms Deliveries at Ukrainian Ports

t: Sever Bay Terminal to Become Largest Northern Oil Port - Putin
d: New Sever Bay terminal will become the largest northern oil port in the world, Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Saturday.

t: Putin Begins Meeting With Witkoff, Kushner – Kremlin
